# RFC TEC

> Precision TIG welding and custom performance automotive fabrication workshop in Archerfield, Brisbane, Queensland, Australia. We build what can't be bought off the shelf.

RFC TEC is a specialist custom fabrication shop in South East Queensland, Australia. Every part is designed, cut, formed and TIG welded in-house for high-performance cars — engine mounts, turbo systems, roll cages, exhausts, chassis work and fuel systems.

## Summary
- 100% custom, one-off fabrication — no bolt-on kits or catalogue parts
- Precision TIG welding for structural and performance applications
- Full in-house capability: design, CAD, fabrication and installation
- Trusted by performance builders, drift, drag, track and street car owners across QLD and Australia

## Services
- Custom TIG welded engine & transmission mounts for any swap
- Intercooler upgrades and full custom aluminium piping
- Hand-fabricated turbo kits, equal-length headers, manifolds and merged collectors
- Complete custom stainless exhaust systems
- Mini tub installs, frame rail work and chassis reinforcement
- Custom roll cages, subframes and structural fabrication
- Aluminium fuel cells, catch cans and fuel system components

**How to get a quote**  
Use the contact form on the website. Visitors can also reveal the phone number on the site to call or text. Provide vehicle details, photos, and goals for fastest response. We typically reply within 24-48 hours.

## Areas Served
Archerfield, Brisbane Southside, Logan, Beenleigh, Gold Coast, Sunshine Coast, Toowoomba, Ipswich and regional Queensland. We welcome builders from across Australia for larger projects.

## Unique Strengths
- Everything fabricated on-site in our Archerfield workshop
- Real photos of finished work — no stock imagery
- Experience across a wide range of platforms and power levels
- Honest advice and transparent quoting process
- "Built Not Bought" philosophy — we only take on projects we can deliver to the highest standard
